metrics.profile_summary: Results-driven marketing professional with over 7 years of experience in integrated marketing strategies. Expert in digital marketing, content strategy, and performance analytics with a proven track record of driving brand growth and lead generation.

experience.description: Leads integrated marketing strategies, multi-channel campaigns, and social media leadership for international IT clients, managing budgets and agency relationships.
Executed digital marketing strategies, performance campaigns (Google/Meta Ads), and CRM automation via HubSpot to drive qualified leads.
Managed paid and organic digital campaigns and conducted competitor analysis to reduce acquisition costs by 35%.
Managed social media channels and content strategies, collaborating with influencers for brand promotions.
Planned integrated marketing campaigns and developed content for digital and offline channels.

strengths: Extensive experience in social media management and content strategy
Proficient in all 'nice-to-have' tools (Canva, Meta Ads, MS Office)
Strong background in agency coordination and performance reporting
Exceeds minimum experience and education requirements
weaknesses: Potentially overqualified for a Specialist-level role
evaluation.summary: The candidate is an exceptional match who exceeds all requirements. They possess senior-level expertise in social media, content coordination, and data-driven reporting, making them highly capable of executing the job duties.
